note: golden_hash filled by golden-parity.test.mjs --update. Vector 1: assets exceed liabilities across every class -- overall COVERED. Vector 2: liabilities exceed assets -- overall SHORTFALL. Vector 3: zero-liabilities edge -- assets on hand with no outstanding liabilities resolves coverage_ratio null, status NO_LIABILITIES_OUTSTANDING, never a division artifact.

vectors.name: seeded_default_covered
vectors.description: Cash, digital-asset, and securities holdings comfortably exceed payables and accrued liabilities -- overall COVERED with a positive surplus.

output_payload.formula: coverage_ratio = total_assets_musd / total_liabilities_musd; surplus_shortfall_musd = total_assets_musd - total_liabilities_musd
output_payload.note: General solvency-shape computation over caller-supplied aggregate totals only (no per-customer or per-wallet line item, no single normative regime anchor). Attests the computation over the inputs supplied, not an audit of their source or a determination of regulatory compliance.
